Open Settings, then Network and internet.
pieces.text: Open Settings, then Network and internet.

pieces.say: Click Wi-Fi, then Manage known networks.
pieces.text: Click Wi-Fi, then Manage known networks.

pieces.say: Pick your network and click Show.

elevenlabsPrompt:
[firm] Still flipping the router over to find the Wi-Fi password?

[confident] Here's the fix. Your laptop already knows it.

[friendly] Open Settings, then Network and internet. Click Wi-Fi, then Manage known networks. Pick your network and click Show.

[delighted] There's the password, plus a QR code your friend can scan.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
